title: Keep viewer navigation menus visible across wrapped layouts
changes: Raise the open wiki category above other navigation rows and prevent the generic open-summary margin from resizing the navbar.
Fit the open menu within the viewport on open and resize, including short mobile screens. Preserve existing category, link, outside-click and Escape behavior.
Publish the navigation-only CSS and JavaScript update to the 47 existing local e378-d377 wiki pages with verified preimages. Preserve each page payload and all unrelated viewer work.
validation: A synthetic Chrome fixture reproduced the Audio menu below subsequent rows and a 16-pixel navbar expansion at 900 pixels. The corrected unit viewer-navbar-final-fgaujl71 passes six focused tests for index and topic pages, wrapped layouts, horizontal and vertical viewport bounds, resize, keyboard Escape and audio deep links.
Independently verified that all 47 published wiki pages match their preimages after only the intended CSS and JavaScript replacements. Both viewer templates embed the updated navigation sources.
limitations: Chrome tests used synthetic viewer data. The existing generated wiki was verified bytewise; physical touch devices and native Windows were not exercised.
